items.problem: Validator raises a spurious '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows' on every zero-deferral migration, costing the dev agent diagnostic turns (R15-R16).
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl R15-R16; Validate-UwpMigration.ps1:267; Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1:480 seeds '| (none) | — |' which never matches the validator's required phrase 'No items deferred'.
items.root_cause: Producer/validator sentinel mismatch on the empty-deferred case.
items.change: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 now treats the bootstrap's '(none)' placeholder row as the clean empty state (accepts it in addition to the literal phrase); Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 now also writes an explicit 'No items deferred.' line so the artifact is self-describing and matches the validator.
items.expected_effect: Zero-deferral migrations validate with a PASS line and no DEFERRED WARN; agents stop spending turns investigating a benign warning.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run that defers nothing, Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 prints '[PASS] No defer rows; MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md correctly notes no items deferred' and no '[WARN] ... mapping has no defer rows'.

items.problem: SKILL.md names the 'MainPage + ListView + Frame (SDK-sample idiom)' shell row but does not enumerate the SDKTemplate helper scaffolding, so the agent spent several turns reconstructing it (R9-R11).
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl R9-R11: planning turns enumerating MainPage.Current, NotifyUser/NotifyType, SampleConfiguration partial MainPage, App.xaml sample styles, and the SDKTemplate->app namespace consolidation.
items.root_cause: Existing shell-conversion guidance is under-specified for the SDKTemplate sample framework shared by the Windows-universal-samples corpus.
items.change: Added a short note under the existing Shell-conversion table listing the SDKTemplate helpers to recreate (static MainPage.Current, NotifyUser/NotifyType, SampleConfiguration as partial MainPage, App.xaml sample text styles) and the SDKTemplate->app namespace consolidation. Sharpens the existing row; no new topic.
items.expected_effect: On SDK-sample migrations the agent recreates the shell helpers directly from the skill instead of reverse-engineering them, reducing planning turns.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any Windows-universal-sample migration, the agent provides MainPage.Current + NotifyUser/NotifyType + the partial SampleConfiguration and consolidates the SDKTemplate namespace without first reverse-engineering them from source over multiple turns.
